sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior repairs. The alternative branch incorrectly inherits gen:ChestBaseShape, which requires recommendedChestVolume and the shared formula for every alternative chest; when coolingWaterChestVolumeAndHeightRequirementsCannotBeMet is true, paragraphs 2 and 3 (volume and ice-height) must be exempt while the other chest requirements remain enforced. Split the common shape or use conditional shapes so alternative chests do not require volume or ice-height. Also, the query merely retrieves maximumContinuousRatingPower without consuming or explicitly relating it to totalRelevantEnginePower, and seaChestVolume is declared as an operand but is only presence-checked and never related or used.
